output.question: Why does a 5.0.9 upgrade downloaded over HTTPS keep failing verification on a 5.0.8 box?
output.reference_answer: On Nimbus NF-300 running 5.0.8, the boot loader is known to reject a valid 5.0.9 image after an HTTPS stage download with %UPGRADE-3-IMAGE_VERIFY_FAIL. The root cause is that 5.0.8 computes the verification digest over the padded image length instead of the actual payload length; HTTPS transfers pad the image to a 4 KB boundary, so the checksum comparison fails even when the file matches the published SHA-256 value. The issue affects 5.0.8 only and is fixed in 5.0.9, which hashes only the unpadded payload.
